title: Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Saturday and Sunday Visit Rate on Trip Charges
content:
A technician visit under Warranty Coverage whose trip charge is billed takes a day rate according to the day it was made:

- a visit made on a **Sunday** takes the Sunday rate of **1.5**;
- a visit made on a **Saturday** takes the Saturday rate of **1.25**;
- a visit made on a weekday takes no weekend rate.

| Day of the visit | Day rate |
|---|---|
| Sunday | 1.5 |
| Saturday | 1.25 |
| Monday to Friday | none |

The day is that of the visit's own date as recorded on the visit. Days of the week follow the ordinary calendar; for reference, 4 January 2026 was a Sunday.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Visit dated | Day | Day rate |
|---|---|---|
| 4 January 2031 | Saturday | 1.25 |
| 5 January 2031 | Sunday | 1.5 |
| 6 January 2031 | Monday | none |
| 18 January 2031 | Saturday | 1.25 |
